title.zh: 停车位（重型车辆停放——豁免）命令 2026
title.en: Parking Places (Parking of Heavy Vehicles — Exemption) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Parking Places (Parking of Heavy Vehicles — Exemption) Order 2026 and comes into operation on 15 September 2026.

3. Section 5(1) of the Act does not apply to a private parking place (called X) if —
(a)X is an eligible parking place;
(b)there is at least one heavy vehicle parked, or to be parked, in X in respect of which a lodgement has been made under rule 7(1) of the Parking Places (Parking of Heavy Vehicles — Lodgement) Rules 2026; and
(c)the lodgement mentioned in sub-paragraph (b) has not lapsed pursuant to rule 8 of the Parking Places (Parking of Heavy Vehicles — Lodgement) Rules 2026.

heading.en: Exemption for owners of heavy vehicles

text.en:
4.—(1) Rule 4 of the Parking Places (Parking of Heavy Vehicles) Rules (R 4) does not apply to the registered owner of, or a person who has purchased, a heavy vehicle if a lodgement is made under rule 7(1) of the Parking Places (Parking of Heavy Vehicles — Lodgement) Rules 2026 to park the heavy vehicle at an eligible parking place.
(2) The exemption in sub‑paragraph (1) applies during the period specified in the lodgement mentioned in that sub‑paragraph as the period the heavy vehicle is to be parked at the eligible parking place.
(3) However, the exemption in sub‑paragraph (1) ceases if the lodgement mentioned in that sub‑paragraph lapses pursuant to rule 8 of the Parking Places (Parking of Heavy Vehicles — Lodgement) Rules 2026.
